name: tw-legal-nlp-bench
description: tw-legal-nlp-bench is a Taiwanese legal-language NLP benchmark collection designed to evaluate models on common legal tasks such as classification, information extraction, and summarization over Taiwan-specific legal texts. It measures a model's ability to understand legal language, extract entities/relations, and produce concise legal summaries or answers. The benchmark focuses on Mandarin/Taiwanese legal corpora and is intended for research on law-domain adaptation and downstream legal applications.
reputation: A niche but useful dataset for Taiwan/Chinese legal NLP research; moderately cited within regional legal-NLP work but not broadly adopted outside that community.
